name: AMBC Juniors Day
venue: Fox Creek MTB Park (upper car park)
summary: A free day of coaching and riding for junior XC riders of all abilities, 10am to 4pm. Spots are limited and club members get first preference. Bring a hardtail or dual suspension bike in good working order, basic spares and a helmet. Entries close Wed 11 Nov.

name: Gravity Girls SA Come & Try Ride
venue: Fox Creek Bike Park, Cudlee Creek
summary: A free, relaxed group ride for women and girls who can ride green singletrack, 11am to 12:30pm. Riders under 14 need an adult with them. Part of Gravity Girls SA's 3rd birthday.

name: AMBC XCO Club Championships
summary: The club's cross-country championship, with categories from Little Shredders (under 9) up to Masters. Racing starts 8:30am. It's on private property, so drive slowly on Oval Road.
